findings.title: Diff calculation throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when prefix and suffix overlap
findings.body:
In `verifySafeHtml()`, the two `while` loops that find the common prefix (`start`) and common suffix (`end`) between `value` and `sanitized` run independently without bounding `start + end` by the lengths of the strings. When the difference occurs next to repeated characters or tags (for example, a duplicate closing tag like `value = "{0}"` vs. `sanitized = "{0}"`, where `start = 20` and `end = 9` for `sanitized.length() == 20`, or an unescaped `>` in `value = "

text>"` vs. `sanitized = "

text>

"`, where `start = 8` and `end = 1` for `value.length() == 8`), `start` exceeds `sanitized.length() - end` or `value.length() - end`. Calling `.substring(start, ... - end)` on line 111 then throws `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` instead of reporting the offending key and file. The second loop condition should also require `start + end < sanitized.length() && start + end < value.length()`.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax breaks i18next interpolation in account-ui
findings.body: `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. Unlike the Freemarker themes under `themes/`, `account-ui` translates user profile validation errors on the client side using `i18next` (which uses double-brace interpolation `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`, as seen in all other `error-*` keys in this file). `i18next` does not parse Java `MessageFormat` placeholders (`{0}`) or `ChoiceFormat` (`{2,choice,...}`), so the placeholders and choice expression will be rendered literally to the user.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax breaks i18next interpolation in admin-ui
findings.body: `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. `admin-ui` formats user profile validation messages client-side with `i18next`, which expects `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}` and does not support Java `MessageFormat` / `ChoiceFormat` syntax (`{0}`, `{2,choice,...}`). As a result, this validation error message will display raw uninterpolated placeholders in the Admin Console.

findings.title: Anchor sanitization is bypassed for English files, matches non-anchor tags, and omits file/key in errors
findings.body:
`santizeAnchors` has three issues:
1. When verifying an `_en.properties` file, `englishFile` resolves to the same file as `file`, so `value` and `englishValue` are identical. Every match in `value` therefore matches itself in `englishValue` and is stripped before `policy.sanitize(value)` runs, allowing arbitrary `<a ...>` tags (including `javascript:` URLs or event handler attributes) in `_en.properties` to bypass the OWASP sanitizer.
2. `ANCHOR_PATTERN` (`</?a[^>]*>`) has no word boundary after `a`, so it also matches any other tag starting with `a` (such as `<audio>`, `<applet>`, `<area>`, `<article>`, or SVG `<animate>`).
3. The error message on line 157 (`"Didn't find anchor tag " + matcher.group() + " in original string"`) omits both `key` and `file`, making it unclear which file and property caused the verification failure.

findings.title: PropertyResourceBundle(InputStream) reads UTF-8 property files as ISO-8859-1
findings.body: `new PropertyResourceBundle(InputStream)` on lines 68 and 77 is specified by the JDK to decode the stream using `ISO-8859-1`, whereas the message `.properties` files in this repository are UTF-8 encoded (and line 49 reads `file` as UTF-8 via `Files.readString`). Reading UTF-8 bytes as `ISO-8859-1` turns non-ASCII translations into mojibake and causes false mismatches or garbled diagnostic output when HTML entities (such as `»` unescaped to `\u00BB`) are compared against raw UTF-8 characters (`\u00C2\u00BB`). Pass a UTF-8 `Reader` (e.g. `Files.newBufferedReader(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)`) to `PropertyResourceBundle` instead.

findings.title: Lithuanian message bundle contains Italian translation for totpStep1
findings.body: In `messages_lt.properties` (Lithuanian), `totpStep1` was replaced with Italian text (`Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`).
